TIDY5E.CHARACTER.Empty:
Getting Started

Start by adding a class and your first items in the Character tab. Then, use the item menu or right-click and choose Add to Sheet tab to add them here.

Customize your Sheet

Choose from Stylistic or Basic sheet themes, update your sheet accent color, or header image by opening the sheet's Overflow menu using the Tidy Theme Settings option.

Sidebar

Save anything to the Sidebar to use later. Use the Overflow menu or right-click anything then Add Favorite to add to the sidebar.

Settings

Update settings for each tab and customize sections using the Configuration button in each tab.

IncludeConsumables.hint: Includes consumables which have an activation cost (Action, Bonus Action, etc) in the Actions list by default.
IncludeConsumables.name: Include Consumables as Actions

IncludeMinuteLongSpells.hint: Includes spells with a duration of one minute or less (e.g. 1 round) and an activation time of 1 Action or 1 Bonus Action (e.g. Bless, Bane, Command) in the Actions tab/panel by default.
IncludeMinuteLongSpells.name: Include Minute-long Spells as Actions

IncludeSpellsWithActiveEffects.hint: Includes spells with active effects attached (e.g. Barkskin) in the Actions tab/panel by default.
IncludeSpellsWithActiveEffects.name: Include Spells with Active Effects as Actions

LimitToCantrips.hint: Instead of showing all spells that deal damage in the Actions tab/panel by default, limits to only cantrips. This is the default D&DBeyond behavior.
LimitToCantrips.name: Limit Actions to Cantrips

Debug.hint: Prints debug messages to the console.
Debug.name: Enable Debugging

Enable.hint: Enable this option to allow the user to set a feature item as an inspiration source. Look for the option as a Context Menu item on feature items with uses.
Enable.name: Enable Banked Inspiration

GmOnly.hint: Enable this option to limit banked inspiration management to the GM.
GmOnly.name: Banked Inspiration Management - GM Only

ContextMenu.hint: Enables right-click context menu on items.
ContextMenu.name: Use Context Menu

IdentificationPermission.hint: Determines which type of user is able to access the UI controls for identifying items.
IdentificationPermission.name: Item Identification Permission

CharacterTabIncludeUsableItems.hint: Automatically include all presently usable items, spells, and features in the sheet tab.
CharacterTabIncludeUsableItems.name: Character Sheet Tab: Automatically Include Usable Items

CharacterTabOrganization.hint: Determines how the sections should be organized in the Character Sheet tab by default.
CharacterTabOrganization.name: Character Sheet Tab Section Organization

option.origin: Group by item or feature type

GlobalCustom.hint: World custom sections which can be configured for various purposes. Global Custom Sections will always be included in the Section Selector.
GlobalCustom.name: Global Custom Sections

GroupSheetMembers.hint: Enables GM control of what group member information a user can see on the group sheet. When the player has no permission to a group member, the group sheet does not show that member or its aggregate information. With Limited permission, the user can see the member's name but no other information. With Observer or greater, the user can see all group sheet information about the member.
GroupSheetMembers.name: Use Group Sheet Member Security

DefaultDeathSaveRoll.hint: Determines the default roll type to use when rolling a death saving throw.
DefaultDeathSaveRoll.name: Default Death Save Roll

DefaultTabs.hint: Determines which tabs will show and in what order by default. Applies when no tab selections have been made for an actor.
DefaultTabs.name: Default Sheet Tabs

InlineActivitiesPosition.hint: When expanding an item, activities for that item are shown. Use this setting to determine if activities are put at the top, before the item description, or bottom, below the item description, buttons, and tags.
InlineActivitiesPosition.name: Inline Activities Position

SwapAbilityScoreAndBonus.hint: Swap the ability score and modifier in sheet headers.
SwapAbilityScoreAndBonus.name: Swap Ability Score and Modifier
SwapAbilityScoreAndBonus.Title: Swap Ability Score and Modifier

IncludeFlagsInScrollCreation.hint: Spells can sometimes contain special data from other modules which can be useful to carry over into a spell scroll. Enable to copy all flag-based data to the spell scroll upon creation.
IncludeFlagsInScrollCreation.name: Include Flags in Spell Scroll Creation
